evals.name: package
evals.prompt: Send the accepted registration example to the implementation team. What goes with it?
evals.expected_output: A scoped revision and success/refusal contract.
assertions: Includes the accepted revision and scope.
Includes the permitted caller, expected keyed fact and row.
Includes the rejected input and observable result.

evals.name: conflict
evals.prompt: The renderer would overwrite an existing target; the domain model already has approval. Continue?
evals.expected_output: Stop at the target authorization boundary.
assertions: Separates model approval from permission to render.
Names the target and conflict for review.

evals.name: parity
evals.prompt: The model runner and renderer passed. Can we mark the usable author journey green?
evals.expected_output: No; run the journey on the permitted target.
assertions: Requires the actual target and compatible pinned dependencies.
Checks exactly one row after submit and reload.
Reports missing backend or permission checks separately.
